member.name: M:Unity.Collections.RewindableAllocator.AllocateNativeList(System.Int32)

summary.para: Allocate a NativeList of type T from memory that is guaranteed to remain valid until the end of the next Update of this World. There is no need to Dispose the NativeList so allocated. It is not possible to free the memory by Disposing it - it is automatically freed after the end of the next Update for this World. The NativeList must be initialized with its maximum capacity; if it were to dynamically resize, up to 1/2 of the total final capacity would be wasted, because the memory can't be dynamically freed.
